The perfect place to explore Vietnamese cuisine
Jul 2026 • Couples
In Nha Trang, the perfect place to explore Vietnamese cuisine and immerse yourself in the atmosphere is just Xóm Mới Garden 🌿

Honestly, I was a little confused on the menu because it's very varied, so I picked up a couple of dishes on the recommendation of the waiter. We picked a lot, thought the portions were normal. But it's the first time I've seen Ban Xeo this size, it's usually much smaller, the other dishes were also big portions. Delicious barbecue meat and spring shrimp rolls. 
The atmosphere is amazing, the place is very photogenic - everything is done in an eco-style, lots of greenery, traditional elements.
I think you can have lunch and dinner here, suitable for a family visit.

Stubborn, even aggressive at time staff and payment problems
Apr 2026 • Family
No complaints to the food, pretty good but there are cockroaches on the floor which turns you off. Waiters force you to pay with cash by refusing to accept cards. They make up stories that their payment terminals are not working and that you have to wait for a repair for twenty minutes post your meal. We were told of the waiting time after ten minutes of aggressive persuasion to pay by cash or exchange dollars right at the restaurant. Moreover, it turned out that the owner of this place were sitting beside us by the table nearby and listening to the whole argument without really dealing with it. She wouldn’t interfere until the issue was escalated. This is not how you should be treated in a place with such a high ranking.
